prompt: The test suite in this repository fails. Find the defect in the application code under shop/ and fix it there, not in the tests. Finish when every test passes.
setup: uv venv .venv -q && uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python pytest==9.1.1
verify: .venv/bin/pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -q 'def test_discount_caps_at_half' tests/test_pricing.py && ! grep -q 'skip' tests/test_pricing.py
solution: sed -i.bak 's/return max(price - discount, price \* 0.4)/return max(price - discount, price * 0.5)/' shop/pricing.py && rm shop/pricing.py.bak
control: - Run the tests with `.venv/bin/pytest -v tests` and read the output.
squeeze: - Run the tests with `.venv/bin/pytest -v tests 2>&1 | squeeze` and read squeeze's output instead of pytest's.
